_note: Runtime emergency-scenario configuration (Phase 12). These are NEVER baked into the historical dataset. At runtime the admin picks a scenario + severity (1-5); the engine temporarily adds `surge_per_severity` x severity to the baseline forecast, then recomputes resource shortages and alerts. Prototype values — clinician review required.

scenarios.name: Dengue / Fever Outbreak
scenarios.description: Vector-borne fever surge (dengue/malaria) — mainly fever & infectious cases.
precautions: Open a dedicated fever screening & triage counter
Prepare additional isolation beds and increase ward nursing
Stock up diagnostic test kits, IV fluids and antipyretics
Issue a vector-control and early-care advisory to villages
Activate an additional physician on-call

scenarios.name: Respiratory Outbreak
scenarios.description: Respiratory illness surge — oxygen and PPE demand rises sharply.
precautions: Verify oxygen cylinder stock and refill logistics
Prepare isolation beds with oxygen support
Ensure adequate PPE for staff
Set up a respiratory triage pathway
Pre-alert facilities with ICU / ventilator capacity

scenarios.name: Diarrhoeal / Flood Surge
scenarios.description: Water-borne / flood-linked surge — gastrointestinal cases and access disruption.
precautions: Stock ORS and IV fluids for rehydration
Issue a safe-drinking-water advisory
Position ambulances for flood-cut villages
Prepare observation beds for rehydration
Coordinate with public-health surveillance

scenarios.name: Festival / Event Surge
scenarios.description: Large gathering — trauma, injuries and general OPD load rise.
precautions: Add emergency-duty doctors and nursing for peak hours
Keep emergency beds and observation space ready
Position ambulances near the event site
Stock wound-care and basic trauma supplies
Brief nearby facilities on possible referrals

scenarios.name: Mass Casualty / Road Accident
scenarios.description: Sudden multi-injury event — sharp trauma spike needing surgery/ICU support.
precautions: Trigger the mass-casualty protocol and recall staff
Clear and ready emergency + surgical beds
Dispatch all available ambulances
Alert blood bank and surgical teams
Immediately request referral capacity from nearby hospitals
